ImageDescription.value: Office Mover employees wheel the Secretary of the Navy’s (SECNAV) desk past the Chief of Naval Operation’s front office door en route to a new office.  The Dept. of the Navy Executive Corridor offices of the SECNAV, Under SECNAV, Chief of Naval Operations (CNO), Commandant of the Marine Corps (CMC), Vice CNO and Assistant CMC, are being relocated, for two years, to office spaces in wedge two within the Pentagon.  The move marks the first time since the opening of the Pentagon that the DoN senior leadership has moved.  U.S. Navy photo by Damon J. Moritz.
